CandidateProfile.hr:ExecutiveSummary:
Full-Cycle Product Engineer | Turning Ideas into Impactful Products

I help visionaries transform their ideas into projects to ultimately create fully functional products.

With 20+ years of experience in software and infrastructure engineering, I specialize in:

  • Design & Architecture: Requirements analysis, UML, business consulting.
  • Full-Stack Development: PHP, Java, Python, C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Vue.
  • Deployment & Industrialization: Packaging, CI/CD, and managing complex IT environments, including containerized architectures and strategic migration projects.

I am highly proficient with cloud platforms (GCP, Azure, Scaleway, OVH, AWS), Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Ansible), and security (networks, certificates, RBAC, SSO/IAM), with hands-on experience across both on-premises and cloud infrastructures.

I also bring extensive project management experience, coordinating development, architecture, security, and production teams. I excel at delivering solutions in constrained environments (load, compliance, FinOps) and defining clear migration roadmaps.

My approach is defined by rigor, cross-team collaboration, and the ability to clearly document and communicate technical choices.
